title: Little Shadows
author: Claude
blurb: Shadows under things, painted with blocks. A game has no see-through colors, so a shadow is pixels drawn into the picture of whatever casts it. Level 1 is a yard of sand, grass and dark soil, played twice: once with a solid shadow under Mara and a walking pip, once with a dithered one, a checkerboard that lets the ground show through. Level 2 is three pips hopping: no shadow, a shadow that never changes, and one that shrinks at the top of the hop. Level 3 is a bee that is two blocks tall, the bee above and its shadow in a block of its own below. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and look at the frames.

box.back: A small explorer in a green beanie walks a courtyard where everything has a shadow. A game has no see-through colors, so a shadow is painted into the picture of the thing that casts it. A solid one is a dark patch. A dithered one is a checkerboard that lets the ground show through. A hop makes the shadow shrink, and a hovering bee gets a shadow block of its own. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and look at the frames.
features: Level 1 paints the same yard with a solid shadow, then a dithered one
Level 2 has three hops: no shadow, one that never changes, one that shrinks
Level 3 has a bee that is two blocks tall, with its shadow below
Made to be copied and taken apart
